Messages.Author: Zsolko
Messages.Body:
Supernatural Resistance

Type: Combat/Reaction
Requires: laibon
Requires a Laibon with three or more Orun.
Tap an Orun on this Laibon to cancel an action card targeting this
Laibon or a strike card as it is played. Not usable to cancel a card
that doesn't require a Discipline or that requires Celerity [cel] or
Potence [pot]. Burn option.

Methuselah A's minion is acting

Methuselah B's vampire blocked the action. Combat. B's vampire plays
Breath of Dragon and want to play a Rotchreck

Methuselah C's laibon with 3 Orun taps one Orun and cancels the B's
strike

QUESTION 1

Can C's laibon play Supernatural Resistance (as a Reaction card) ?

QUESTION 1 / A
Can C forgoing the playing the Rotschreck ?

Messages.Author: henrik
Messages.Body:
On Jul 16, 1:44 pm, Zsolko <zso...@ejot.sk> wrote:

> Methuselah A's minion is acting
>
> Methuselah B's vampire blocked the action. Combat. B's vampire plays
> Breath of Dragon and want to play a Rotchreck
>
> Methuselah C's laibon with 3 Orun taps one Orun and cancels the B's
> strike
>
> QUESTION 1
>
> Can C's laibon play Supernatural Resistance (as a Reaction card) ?

Nope.
Rulebook, section 6.4:
Note: The only minion cards that can be played during combat are
combat cards (unless a card states otherwise, of course).

I'm fairly sure that a combat card needs enabling text to be playable
by another minion outside combat, so it probably won't work to play it
as a combat card either. Not 100 % on this one though.
